newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Goldfields annual gold production rises.
newsitem.headline: Goldfields annual gold production rises.

text.p: Gold miner Goldfields Ltd said on Wednesday it produced 129,485 ounces of gold in the June quarter for annual production to June 30 of 505,785 ounces at a cash cost of A$345 per ounce.
This compared with 448,402 ounces at a cash cost of A$348 per ounce in the year to June 30, 1996.
Goldfields said the average received gold price for the quarter was A$579 per ounce, compared with an average spot price of about A$445.
At June 30, a mark to market valuation of gold hedging positions showed an unrealised gain of A$208 million, it said.
Goldfields is about 57 percent owned by RGC Ltd, and holds 87.2 percent of Pancontinental Mining Ltd.
